coverage: At least one completed current-round 64-CPU MARK* design per system, elapsed strictly under 336 hours; approaching 14 days is a preference, not a reason to sacrifice coverage.

coverage_unconfirmed.2xxm_flex_p1: Confirm previously started task; retain 2xxm_flex_p3 as conditional fallback until coverage is confirmed.

rules: All completed and running designs remain protected, including low speedup results.
Previously started but unconfirmed designs are protected until checked.
Defer means remove from automatic launch order; retain configurations, results and rollback manifests.
Recheck live pending state before any implementation; skip any task that has started since this plan snapshot.
For a system without a completed 64-CPU design, retain at least one lower-tier fallback until coverage is achieved.
3bua m4 is a proposed lower-tier design, not a guaranteed completion; use an early short pilot and reduce further if necessary.
Measure new PACK* tiers and check sequence/status compatibility before spending a long MARK* slot.
Prefer PACK* under 20 minutes; beyond 30 minutes launch only with strong evidence for a large ratio.
Use measured current MARK* / measured current PACK* for speedup, and elapsed / PACK* only as a labelled lower bound for timeouts.
Pin all newly scheduled tiers of each system to a single actual CPU model; keep hardware details with existing heterogeneous results.
New 3gxu and 2q1e tiers may move to DCC because their local cases have not started; preserve all existing running jobs.
One primary long target per system at a time; reserves launch only after coverage and GPU measurements support them.
After October 16 do not launch a new job that needs a full 14-day observation before the October 30 data freeze.
user_scope: All unstarted work can be reprioritized; all started work and completed results remain protected.

local_adjustment.user_scope: Only started work is protected; unstarted work on all clusters is reprioritized.
